Name: Skull Cave Auto Pause
Author: kun2331
Description:
When entering each layer of the desert mine, time will automatically pause and resume passing after closing the dialog box. [color=#ff0000]Only effective in single player.[/color] This mod pause time by calling a dialog box, therefore, you should check the game setting "Pause When Game Window Is Inactive". This function has been implemented by the mod [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25161]"Quick Descend By Using Staircase (N: 25161)"[/url].


当进入沙漠矿井的每一层时，时间会自动暂停，并在关闭对话框后继续流逝。[color=#ff0000]仅在单人游戏中生效。[/color]这个功能通过调用对话框来暂停时间，因此，需要勾选游戏设置“游戏窗口未激活时暂停”。这个功能已被模组[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25161]"Quick Descend By Using Staircase (N: 25161)"[/url]﻿实现。
